Rule.name: Delegate Financial App Entitlements to AppSec
Rule.Description:
Routes certifiable entitlements on a designated high-risk application to a dedicated application-security reviewer instead of the identity's default certifier (typically their manager), regardless of certification type or trigger (scheduled recurrence or Certification Event).
Configure on Certifications > Certification Schedule > Advanced Settings, the same place as an Exclusion Rule. Returning null leaves the certifier assignment untouched for that item, so the rule only overrides the specific entitlements it matches and is safe to attach broadly.
Validate with a Staged run before attaching to a live recurring or event-driven campaign -- a typo in the returned identity name fails silently (the item keeps its default certifier) with no error in the UI.
